material.acceptance_criteria: /state, /delta and order replies carry a protocol version, and a client sending an unsupported version is refused with a named error.
material.description: /state, /delta and order replies carry a protocol version, and a client sending an unsupported version is refused with a named error.
material.resolution: PROTOCOL_VERSION = 1 is on every /state, /delta and order reply, and a request with a different ?proto= gets 409 protocol_mismatch. CI checks the 409 on /state; /delta and order refusals share the same check but are not asserted in CI (follow-up gap-protocol-refusal-all-replies). Error bodies carry no proto.
material.subject: Wire protocol is unversioned; clients cannot detect a mismatched server
material.witness_plan: CI curl check asserts a protocol field is present and a bad version gets 409 protocol_mismatch. Evidence: rust/crates/server/src/lib.rs:330 and :380 format state JSON with only version/tick and state_hash; no protocol field exists.
